name: Trips persist after reloading the page

planSteps.description: Navigate to /?today=2026-10-19&fresh=1 (pins today to 2026-10-19 and clears saved trips in storage key ninety.trips.v1)
Click the add trip button (data-testid=trip-add), enter entry 2026-09-01 and exit 2026-09-10 (data-testid=trip-entry, trip-exit) and click save (data-testid=trip-save)
Navigate to /?today=2026-10-19 (without fresh=1, so saved trips are kept)
Exactly one trip row (data-testid=trip-row) for 2026-09-01 to 2026-09-10 is shown
Days used still shows 10 and days left (data-testid=days-left) shows 80
